slides.title: A call to Addis Ababa
slides.body: Kenya's Musalia Mudavadi says he spoke with Ethiopian Foreign Minister Gedion Timotheos and urged him to calm the situation so people can return home.

slides.title: people evacuated to Kenya
slides.body: Mudavadi's figure for people sheltering in Moyale. Other estimates are higher.

slides.title: Clashes continue
slides.body: Wazema Radio reports fighting between Oromia and Somali regional forces continued this week. Residents said federal forces had not deployed as of Monday.

slides.title: Stray fire across the border
slides.body: The Star cites reports of suspected stray bullets and unexploded explosives landing on the Kenyan side. Kenya sent extra police on Nov 5.

slides.title: Protect civilians on both sides of the border.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: The Star (Kenya), Nov 9; Wazema Radio, Nov 10, 2026
